scope: Follow-up after the calendar loop (rounds 120–128), all dates: LT/EE history reuse, the Aleksandrīna fixture, open LT histories and other cached sources for names still open.

changes.reuse: reusedHistory now also serves LT (LT variants, then LV) and EE (EE variants, then LV). LT and EE never borrow from each other, because identical forms there are often unrelated native names (Milda, Mėta, Aina). Cross-country reuse for LT/EE keeps only the origin paragraph; an LV history whose explanation rests on Latvian material is not reused. Result: 28 LT and 16 EE names gain a reused history with a note.
changes.fixture: parsers/namedays.test.mjs: the diacritic-variant test now uses the synthetic Ziedrīna/Ziedrina instead of Aleksandrīna; the checked Siliņš history of Aleksandrīna (Rēzekne 1872) was then written in the round 128 module.

lv.rule: Siliņš entries whose origin is marked (?) or —? keep no origin claim; the page images were checked for the region and the first dated record only. Calendar years are not used here because the text layer can attach them to the neighbouring entry.

lt.rule: Senn–Salys (1968) proper-name list in Salys 1983, PDF pp. 202–281: only entries with a stated German/Latin equivalent (PN …), a short-form mark (KF von …) or an equation (=) were used, each checked on the page images. Entries marked PN without an equivalent stay open.

ee.rule: Rajandi 1966 supplementary list (PDF 189–225): the first source reference after each exact headword, decoded from the book register (EO 63 = 1963 national list; Tln/Trt/Nm/Pd/Elv = birth registers of Tallinn, Tartu, Nõmme, Paide and Elva districts; MT = Tõnisson calendars; Mg 29/36 = Mägiste 1929/1936 lists; Ans = Ansomardi 1903). Undecoded codes (Hiis 38, EK 37, Võ, OK3, 35/40, Rv) and surname records (pn) were not used.

leads_file: var/namedays-research/open-leads129.json (workspace root, private): every name still open, with the cached sources whose text contains it as a word.
next: Work through open-leads129.json source by source (LV: LV-LVA-* rendering records, LV-BALODIS08, LV-PLESUMA-BALODE12/13; LT: LT-LPZ, LT-ZINKEVICIUS77, LT-BUGA-RR1; EE: EE-MAGISTE36, EE-MAGISTE29-AES); acquire Kuzavinis & Savukynas (2009) for LT.
